auth.description: API Key for Echowin. Get it from [Echowin Settings](https://echo.win/portal/settings/integrations)

createContact.name: createContact
createContact.description: Create a new contact with optional tags, custom fields, notes, and board assignments

number.description: Contact phone number (will be automatically cleaned)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in the Echowin CRM. Requires a phone number; first/last name, email, and carrier are optional. Use when adding a person to Echowin. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate contact even with identical input.

contactId.description: The unique identifier of the contact to delete

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a contact from the Echowin CRM, identified by its unique contact ID. Use when removing a known contact; obtain the ID from a find/list step first. Idempotent in effect — once the contact is gone, repeating the call leaves it absent.

findContactByName.name: findContactByName
findContactByName.description: Get a paginated list of contacts and search by name, email, or phone number

search.description: Search contacts by name, email, or phone number

aiMetadata.description: Looks up contacts in the Echowin CRM. With a search value it filters contacts matching the given name, email, or phone number; leaving search empty returns the full paginated contact list. Use to resolve a contact or browse contacts. Read-only and idempotent.

newContact.name: newContact
newContact.description: Trigger when a new contact is created in Echowin

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new contact is created in the Echowin CRM. Polls for contacts whose creation time is later than the last check, emitting one event per newly created contact.
